notes.content:

Hi guys

I am happy to anounce that my [url=store.steampowered.com/app/657530/Impresja/] latest project[/url] - a first person puzzle / exploration game - is due to release on Steam on 27th of July. 

Feel free to check it out.

Thanks
Adam

notes.title: Wave Mechanics update released
notes.content:
List of new features:

-steam achievements
-new ambient soundtrack
-undo button
-puzzles now unlock in groups giving you a choice as to which one you want to play next
-music on/off button
-vertical sync is now enabled to avoid unnecessary GPU load
